featured_reviews.review_text: IGCSE curriculum is very tough, and it was a horror for me when suddenly one day in August my child declared (in a state of tears) "you need to take my studies, otherwise I won't pass". I struggled for a week with IG Physics and Chemistry and realized what I have studied and what they have is far advanced and not my cup of tea. As working parents sometimes you miss the signs in front of you that the child needed personal attention, whereas I had enrolled her in mass classes which had not helped her. I had also believed her when she said she would prefer no classes and wanted to self study. Realized I can't teach her, and if she doesn't get the right support she won't qualify. In a state of panic I reached out to Tiveni Sir for private tuitions, who, with the Boards just 3 months away, took this case as a challenge. Together with his team, Ms. Mamta and Mr. Rahul, they covered Physics, Chemistry, Math and Biology. As a parent I was very afraid if I was pushing my child too much, rather than choosing the easier path of Core curriculum, or even worse, selecting easy subjects, but I thought if I won't push her,  then who will. Her hard work coupled with the guidance of these patient teachers turned things around for her in 3-months, and my belief in my child's capability was proven right. Thanks Triveni Sir for taking up this challenge, and bringing together a winning team who ensured success against odds is very much possible.
